1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.277/2019 PS Vikas Puri under section 498A/406/34 IPC on the basis of settlement between the parties dated 15th July, 2022 which is on record of this Court.
As per the settlement final balance sum of Rs.5 lacs is to be paid to respondent no.2 at the stage of quashing proceedings.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners however submits that Rs.50,000/- has already been paid to the respondent no.2 at the time of second motion and as such, balance of Rs.4,50,000/- remains to be paid to her.
3. Respondent no.2 is not available as she is out of town, as informed by the learned counsel for the petitioners.
4. Appearance of petitioner no.2, who is a senior citizen, is exempted for
